status: frozen on 2026-10-22 together with docs/analysis-spec.md; change only through the spec amendment log

cohort.description: Historical accepted archive, original masks; no fresh generation before the frozen evaluation

sensitivity.reason: Accepted clothing issue flagged in docs/approval-receipt.json

detached_hand.primary_description: Paper-matched: skin-only hand on black, cut at the wrist; derived from each family's own full-body pixels
detached_hand.sensitivity_description: Historical rectangle with desk patch and part of the wrist (accepted archive)
detached_hand.segmentation: SAM-HQ ViT-B on the final V7 frames (pinned checkpoint and code)

reference_images.origin: AI-generated grayscale reference pairs (normal1-20 / open1-20), stated by the project owner on 2026-10-22
reference_images.identities: 20 different synthetic people; no person repeats
reference_images.limit: Independent in identity only: one generator, one scene template and one camera geometry; no claim about real people's hands

source_metadata.reference_sex: 10 female / 10 male; apparent sex of the V7 images confirmed to match by the project owner on 2026-10-22

hand_pixel_deviation.result: 144/480 families (references 10, 11, 12, 16, 18, 20); at most 645 visible pixels (0.65% of the hand); largest difference 6/255; identical in static and movement frames
hand_pixel_deviation.decision: Keep all 480 families; no exclusion or sensitivity analysis for these deviations
hand_pixel_deviation.spec_impact: None: consistent with the frozen cohort definition; no amendment required

human_data.type_map_evidence: Fitting the paper's mixed model with Type 1 as Movement reproduces every legible Table 2 coefficient, including the sign of Type x FDI

scales.participant_z: Paper Methods: per participant, (MEP - participant mean) / participant SD over all retained MEPs, both muscles; SD with n - 1
scales.raw_mv: Deposited amplitude in mV; the scale of the paper's published mixed model (Table 2)
scales.log: Natural log of amplitude in microvolts; MEP amplitudes are right-skewed
scales.participant_muscle_z: As participant_z, but separately within each muscle
scales.participant_z_min50: MEPs below 50 microvolts removed first (the paper's stated cutoff), then participant_z

published_table2.source: Table 2, Sci Rep 15:13364; only values legible in the article are transcribed
published_table2.model: Linear mixed model on raw mV (not the z-scored values described in Methods), participant random intercept, fixed body x movement x muscle; references full body, static, ADM

published_posthoc_abs_z.source: Results text; reproduced by separate random-intercept models on each subset. Table 3 differs for some cells (FDI movement 9.01 and 9.01, FDI static 5.59 and 4.89)

controls.rendering: On demand from each family full-body image (scripts/controls.py render); no stored image archive
controls.visual_review: approved by the project owner on 2026-10-22 (docs/controls-approval.json)

model.encoder_primary_description: OpenCLIP ViT-bigG-14 laion2b_s39b_b160k, encode_image before L2 normalisation, 224 px
model.decision_rule_addition: P1 in the same direction with both robustness encoders
model.h2_context: contiguous forearm continuity below the wrist, palm widths, capped at 1 (model/context.py; data/context_continuity.json)
model.h2_gate: g = c + (1 - c) a, one parameter c fitted on training sources to the human DH/FB ratio
model.s3_low_level_alternative: global visible-area fraction with the same gate, compared on the matched control pairs
